title: Shipment workflow — explicit state machine
prompt: Refactor the shipment status field into an explicit state machine. Define allowed transitions; reject illegal ones with a clear error. Add tests for both legal and illegal transitions. Persist transitions in an audit log.

hard_gates.name: illegal-transitions-rejected
hard_gates.description: DRAFT → COMPLETED, RECEIVED → IN_TRANSIT, COMPLETED → DRAFT all return error

hard_gates.name: audit-log-written
hard_gates.description: Every transition writes an immutable audit row with actor + timestamp
